h1: Custom 17 oz Stationery for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom 17 oz stationery in bulk. Perfect for branded notebooks, planners, and more. Get your quote at Perfect Imprints today.
introHtml: Custom 17 oz stationery offers a substantial feel that lighter options lack. The heavier paper weight resists ink bleed and holds up to daily use, making it ideal for branded notebooks, planners, or memo pads you want to last. Marketing directors and HR managers often choose this weight for client gifts or employee welcome kits where quality matters. Decorate with foil stamping, embossing, or full-color print to match your brand identity.
heroAltText: Custom 17 oz stationery including branded notebooks and planners with foil stamping
